# Dayan Agent Skills

Canonical repository: https://github.com/Kosmoray/dayan-agent-skills
Live demo: https://kosmoray.github.io/dayan-agent-skills/

Available public betas:

- 56 installable public beta Skills are listed in catalog.json.
- Dayan Wenzhen: falsifiable task contracts for vague or risky requests.
- Dayan Deck: an HTML-first presentation Skill with a structural verifier and explicit human-review boundaries.
- Dayan Adversarial Reviewer: an evidence-backed engineering review Skill with a machine-verifiable JSON verdict.

Useful entry points:

- https://github.com/Kosmoray/dayan-agent-skills/blob/main/docs/quickstart.md
- https://github.com/Kosmoray/dayan-agent-skills/blob/main/docs/choose-a-skill.md
- https://github.com/Kosmoray/dayan-agent-skills/blob/main/docs/playbooks/README.md
- https://github.com/Kosmoray/dayan-agent-skills/blob/main/examples/runs/README.md

Current public package release: 0.7.0-beta.1. The example-run index contains 11 sanitized scenarios.
